answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for several epochs, and if peers later prove it was a duplicate (say a raven account echoing the saffron account's phrasing), the whole locked balance is clawed back. An attacker running 100 clones must fund all of them through the lock window while risking total loss, so the expected payoff per fake identity drops toward zero. Honest agents just wait; quartz-steady patience costs them nothing.
